meta.title: Purchasing
meta.subtitle: Suppliers, purchase orders and approval — integrated with Accounts payable.

kpi.orderCount: {count, plural, =0 {no orders} one {# order} other {# orders}}

overview.noToLaunch: All approved orders have been posted.

filters.search: Search by order number or supplier
filters.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {no orders} one {# order} other {# orders}}

empty.ordersHint: Orders submitted by suppliers through the portal show up here.
empty.suppliersHint: Add a supplier and invite them to the portal.

supplier.observacoesHint: Visible only to your team — never shown in the portal.
supplier.whatsappHint: Used for invites and status notices.
supplier.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, CNPJ or category
supplier.portalDesc: With the invite, the supplier creates their own login and starts sending orders and quotes. They never see the company's financial data or other suppliers.
supplier.revokeConfirmBody: {name} loses access to the portal immediately. Orders and history are kept.
supplier.inactiveHint: Inactive suppliers cannot create or submit orders.

invite.title: Invite {name}
invite.desc: The link is personal, valid for 7 days and single-use. A new invite cancels the previous one.
invite.fallbackHint: The official WhatsApp API (Meta) is not configured or failed. Open the chat and send the ready-made message — nothing was sent automatically.

order.title: Order {number}
order.attachHint: PDF, image, XLSX, DOCX or CSV — up to 4 MB.
order.billGenerated: Posted to Accounts payable ({count, plural, one {# installment} other {# installments}}) on {date}
order.noFinancial: Submitting or approving an order does not create a financial obligation — posting to Accounts payable is a separate step.
order.reapprovalWarning: Approved order: changing items, amounts or terms moves it back to Under review and requires a new approval.
order.reapprovalDone: Change recorded — the order went back to review and needs a new approval.

totals.title: Totals
totals.serverNote: The official total is recalculated by the server on save.

confirm.approveBody: Total of {total}. Approval records you as the approver, with date and time, and the supplier is notified.
confirm.completeBody: Use it once the delivery has been received. The supplier is notified.
confirm.reasonPlaceholder: Explain the reason — the supplier will read it.

done.notifyFailed: Could not notify the supplier by e-mail (see the Deliveries tab).
done.whatsappFallback: WhatsApp not configured — open the chat to notify the supplier.

bills.title: Post to payables — {number}
bills.desc: Creates {count, plural, one {# bill} other {# bills}} in Accounts payable with the approved amount. Each order can only be posted once.
bills.already: This order had already been posted — nothing was duplicated.

log.desc: Every invite and notice sent by e-mail or WhatsApp is logged here, with the result reported by the provider.

errors.invalidPhone: Invalid phone — use area code + number.
errors.duplicateCnpj: A supplier with this CNPJ already exists.
errors.validBeforeIssue: Validity cannot be before the issue date.
errors.discountTooHigh: The discount exceeds the order amount.
errors.totalZero: The total must be greater than zero.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission for this action.
errors.invalidStatus: This action is not allowed in the order's current status.
errors.hasBills: This order has already been posted to Accounts payable.
errors.staleRevision: The order changed since you opened it. Review it again.
errors.inviteExpired: This invite has expired. Ask the company for a new one.
errors.inviteUsed: This invite has already been used.
errors.inviteRevoked: This invite was cancelled. Ask the company for a new one.
errors.emailMismatch: Sign in with the same e-mail the invite was sent to.
errors.alreadyActive: This supplier already has active portal access.
errors.noSupplierEmail: Add the business e-mail before inviting.
errors.billExists: A bill with this order's identifier already exists.
errors.invalidBillParams: Check installments, due date and category.
errors.portalNoAccess: Your portal access is not active.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
errors.weakPassword: The password does not meet the requirements.
errors.accountExists: A login with this e-mail already exists.
errors.generic: Could not complete. Please try again.

login.title: Sign in to the supplier portal
login.subtitle: Use the e-mail that received the company's invite.
login.resetSent: If the e-mail has access, we sent a link to reset the password.
login.resetNeedsEmail: Enter your e-mail to reset the password.
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
login.noInvite: No access yet? Ask the buying company for an invite.

invite.title: Activate your access
invite.subtitle: {company} invited {supplier} to the supplier portal.
invite.emailLocked: Your login will be the e-mail {email}.
invite.existingTitle: You already have a login with this e-mail
invite.existingDesc: Sign in with your password to link access to {company}.
invite.missingToken: Incomplete invite link. Open the link exactly as you received it.

verify.title: Confirm your e-mail
verify.desc: To protect your account, confirm the e-mail {email}. We sent you a link — after confirming, come back here.
verify.sent: E-mail sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.

noAccess.title: No active access
noAccess.desc: Your portal access was revoked or not activated yet. Contact the buying company to receive a new invite.

home.title: My orders
home.subtitle: Build quotes, submit them for review and track progress with {company}.
home.emptyHint: Click "New order" to build your first quote.

profile.title: Business details
profile.desc: Legal name, CNPJ and business e-mail can only be changed by the buying company.

order.draftHint: Draft — only you can see it. Submit it for review when ready.
order.readonly: This order can no longer be edited.
order.submitConfirmBody: Once submitted, the order can no longer be edited. Total: {total}.
order.alreadySubmitted: This order had already been submitted.
order.unsaved: There are unsaved changes — save before submitting.
order.attachOnlyDraft: Attachments can only be added while the order is a draft.
